thread:
alex: Quick sync 1: Aurora Marketplace private offer draft for co-sell with Nebula Systems. Need signoff on commit bands, trial pool, HW credit, and renewal mechanics. @rita @sam @leo please weigh in
rita: Nice. Can we keep a low friction entry? propose $30k entry band. Lowers legal churn.
sam: Legal note: HW credits flagged for export controls + need discrete language for "on-invoice credit" vs rebate. Also want a 30-day opt-out window on first 90 days.
leo: Sales POV: $30k ok, but add $20k trial bucket for top prospects. Also suggest a usage floor clause so customers don't drain trial then churn.
tanya: Finance: discount tiers need blended margin calc. Proposed discounts: 8% / 14% / 20% for 30k/200k/900k. Renewal credit = on-invoice credit up to 25% of renewal invoice, not > unused commit.
alex: Draft offer below (rough) 
```
Aurora + Nebula Co-sell Private Offer (draft)
Commit bands:
- Starter: $30,000 commit -> 8% discount, 5% on-invoice renewal credit cap, 6mo activation window
- Growth: $200,000 commit -> 14% discount, 12% on-invoice renewal credit cap, 9mo activation window
- Scale: $900,000 commit -> 20% discount, 18% on-invoice renewal credit cap, 12mo activation window
Trial bucket: $20k (applied as API credits) for prioritized prospects, expires 90 days
HW credit: up to $120k appliance credit (subject to export review and customs), delivered as invoice credit after deployment
Marketplace SKU mapping: public-API tokens for Starter, reserved-capacity SKUs for Growth/Scale
Renewal mechanics: credits apply as on-invoice line item; cannot exceed 25% of next-year invoice; unused commit counts toward auto-renew eligibility; opt-out permitted within first 30 days of contract
GTM: joint announcement 3 weeks after first customer go-live; co-marketing fund $30k on 12mo Scale commit
```
rita: Looks good. Two asks: 1) make trial bucket non-transferable, 2) cap HW credits per customer at $50k unless exec approval.
sam: I'll add export + customs clause and the opt-out wording. Will share redline by EOD Thu.
leo: Can we include a short SLA for Dedicated/Private deployments? even 99.5% or a statement about response times. Buyers ask.
tanya: SLA will affect price. If we promise 99.5% for Scale, we should model cost. I'll run numbers and post a blended margin table.
finance-bot: Reminder: attach cost model worksheet when you share margin calc.
alex: Action items: @sam legal redline; @tanya margin calc + cost model; @leo draft minimal SLA language; @rita confirm trial non-transferability and HW cap; I'll produce a clean PO draft for partner review by Fri.
rita: Ping when PO draft is ready; I'll do a quick commercial review.
leo: I'll map the bands to Dedicated SKU names and send SKU mapping doc tomorrow morning.
sam: Redline uploaded to the thread: https://drive.redwood/aurora-nebula/redline.docx
rita: :thumbsup: Good progress. Meeting with Nebula on Mon 9am PT to present this.
alex: Thanks team. Bringing this to Nebula with the caveat: final signoff requires finance margin sign-off and legal redline resolution.
